emma_cs: Quick lightweight handoff for Skyline renewal kickoff tomorrow. One-page cheat (cache/batch/stream) + what CS watches for renewal risk. Paste below, please quick review.

emma_cs: SUMMARY
- Start conservative: cache-first, small warm pool, batch to save costs, stream for interactive demos. Watch p95 latency and cache hit-rate as renewal signals.

emma_cs: RUNBOOK (customer-facing, single sheet)
1) Launch prep
- Warm pool: set to 1.1-1.3x projected TPS first 2 hours.
- Telemetry owner: platform-observability. Make sure p95 latency, 5xx rate, cache-hit-rate are on their dashboard.

2) Cache (simple advice)
- Use prefix caching for repeated starts (e.g., system prompts). Threshold: enable if >20% identical beginnings.
- TTL guidance: 5-10m for session prompts, 12-24h for static prompts. Use stale-while-revalidate for UX smoothing.
- Quick validation: run the curl smoke test below to see x-cache header.

curl test:
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"prompt":"whoami","cache_key":"skyline_who_v1"}' -i
```
Second identical request should show header: x-cache: HIT

3) Batching (customer-facing knobs)
- When many short requests (<150 tokens) batching reduces cost. Start window=10ms, maxWindow=50-75ms depending on SLA.
- Max batch size: 64 on heavy nodes, 32 on smaller nodes. Probe traffic during business hours so we can tune.

4) Streaming (UX tips)
- Use streaming for interactive UIs. Flush partial tokens every 40-80ms or on sentence boundary.
- Fallback: retry stream once after 200ms; if still failing call non-stream endpoint.

5) Degradation & rollback (keep it simple)
- Fallback order: primary -> quantized fast variant -> smaller-context model.
- Circuit-breaker: open if 5xx > 3% on 60s window; cool down 30s.
- Rollback trigger: p95 latency >2x baseline for 3m -> set cache TTL=0 and reduce batch window to 5ms.

6) Renewal-risk signals we watch (CS Ops)
- Rising p95 latency or falling cache-hit-rate week-over-week.
- Increased error bursts or rising token costs without latency improvement.
- Low developer satisfaction (NPS < 6 at day 7).
- Action: if any signal breached, schedule a 30min joint triage (CS+SRE+Eng) and propose either warm-pool increase or batch/window tuning.

carla_cs: Small ask: can we include who owns the follow-up thread? I'll take it and post chosen TTLs/batch settings after the call.

emma_cs: Thanks — noted: follow-up owner = carla_cs.

ryan_sre: Ops note: for Dedicated tenants cap per-tenant cache entries (suggest 5000) and enable soft eviction under memory pressure. Trace sampling: 10% first 48h, then 1%.

oliver_eng: Add sample circuit-breaker JSON for them to paste into their config: {"failure_threshold_pct":"3","evaluation_window_ms":"60000","open_duration_ms":"30000"}
